package domain

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const AssignedLessonContextSchema = "student-assigned-lesson-context.v1"
const AssignedLessonContextMaxBytes = 2 << 20

type AssignedLessonContent struct {
	Title       string `json:"title"`
	Excerpt     string `json:"excerpt"`
	Description string `json:"description"`
}

// AssignedLessonContext contains only exact frozen learner-visible strings.
// Tasks, translations, and private evaluation material never enter this projection.
type AssignedLessonContext struct {
	Schema             string                `json:"schema"`
	StudentID          string                `json:"student_id"`
	LearningPathID     string                `json:"learning_path_id"`
	LearningPathItemID string                `json:"learning_path_item_id"`
	CourseID           string                `json:"course_id"`
	LessonID           string                `json:"lesson_id"`
	LessonRevisionID   string                `json:"lesson_revision_id"`
	ContentDigest      string                `json:"content_digest"`
	Content            AssignedLessonContent `json:"content"`
}

func canonicalAssignedUUID(value string) bool {
	id, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && id != uuid.Nil && id.String() == value
}

// ProjectAssignedLessonContext selects one unambiguous assignment; lifecycle
// eligibility belongs to commands and is deliberately not applied to this read.
func ProjectAssignedLessonContext(path StudentLearningPath, itemID string) (AssignedLessonContext, error) {
	if !canonicalAssignedUUID(path.ID) || !canonicalAssignedUUID(path.StudentID) || !canonicalAssignedUUID(path.CourseID) || !canonicalAssignedUUID(itemID) {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrValidation
	}
	var item *LearningPathItem
	for i := range path.Items {
		if path.Items[i].ID == itemID {
			if item != nil {
				return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrConflict
			}
			item = &path.Items[i]
		}
	}
	if item == nil {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrNotFound
	}
	if item.ReferenceType != "lesson" || !canonicalAssignedUUID(item.ReferenceID) || !canonicalAssignedUUID(item.LessonRevisionID) {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrValidation
	}
	fields, err := assignedFrozenFields(item.LessonContent)
	if err != nil {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrValidation
	}
	// Identity fields are not required in Course's content object; when present
	// they must agree with the enclosing frozen assignment.
	for key, expected := range map[string]string{"course_id": path.CourseID, "lesson_id": item.ReferenceID, "lesson_revision_id": item.LessonRevisionID, "learning_path_id": path.ID, "learning_path_item_id": item.ID} {
		if raw, ok := fields[key]; ok {
			var value string
			if json.Unmarshal(raw, &value) != nil || value != expected {
				return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrValidation
			}
		}
	}
	var content AssignedLessonContent
	for key, target := range map[string]*string{"title": &content.Title, "excerpt": &content.Excerpt, "description": &content.Description} {
		raw, ok := fields[key]
		if !ok || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("null")) || json.Unmarshal(raw, target) != nil || !utf8.ValidString(*target) {
			return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if utf8.RuneCountInString(content.Title) > 1000 || utf8.RuneCountInString(content.Excerpt) > 4000 || len(content.Description) > 1<<20 {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrValidation
	}
	exact, _ := json.Marshal([3]string{content.Title, content.Excerpt, content.Description})
	digest := sha256.Sum256(exact)
	result := AssignedLessonContext{Schema: AssignedLessonContextSchema, StudentID: path.StudentID, LearningPathID: path.ID, LearningPathItemID: item.ID, CourseID: path.CourseID, LessonID: item.ReferenceID, LessonRevisionID: item.LessonRevisionID, ContentDigest: "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]), Content: content}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil || len(encoded) > AssignedLessonContextMaxBytes {
		return AssignedLessonContext{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}

// Retain only the top-level object during parsing, rejecting ambiguous duplicate
// fields rather than choosing an arbitrary stored value.
func assignedFrozenFields(raw json.RawMessage) (map[string]json.RawMessage, error) {
	if !utf8.Valid(raw) {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	token, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil || token != json.Delim('{') {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	fields := map[string]json.RawMessage{}
	for decoder.More() {
		token, err := decoder.Token()
		key, ok := token.(string)
		if err != nil || !ok {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := fields[key]; exists {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		var value json.RawMessage
		if decoder.Decode(&value) != nil {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		fields[key] = value
	}
	if token, err = decoder.Token(); err != nil || token != json.Delim('}') {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	if decoder.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	return fields, nil
}
